items.name: Valence Viaduct
items.depicts: A wide semiconductor energy-band diagram with a dark navy conduction band above a cyan valence band, linked by five vertical transition rails each holding a pale blue carrier.

items.name: Fermi Strait
items.depicts: Two parallel horizontal energy bands in cyan and dark navy separated by a narrow white gap containing two pale blue carrier specks.

items.name: Evanescent Wall
items.depicts: A tall vertical cyan potential barrier with a single square notch emerging along its left face to indicate a particle passing through.

items.name: Bloch Wave
items.depicts: A pale ice-blue stepped pixel sine wave oscillating horizontally across a dark field.

items.name: Positive Absence
items.depicts: A hollow cyan octagonal pixel ring with an empty white interior representing an absent electron.

items.name: Optical Promotion
items.depicts: A diagonal pale blue photon ray striking a dark navy valence bar while a cyan carrier block sits elevated above it.

items.name: Radiative Fall
items.depicts: A horizontal dark navy barrier separating a pale blue square above from a cyan square below, animated to show carrier recombination.

items.name: Tunnel Drifter
items.depicts: A dark charcoal hollow square body with two asymmetrical grey side stubs that floats and snaps along a grid.
